text: dsh-market-dock 是面向 DSH web 的行情面板插件，在对话输入区、悬浮层和输入框旁接入行情界面，并注册 Agent 查询工具。用户可查看 A 股、港股和美股行情、K 线与分时、热榜、快讯和搜索，也能维护本地持仓、计算盈亏、设置价格提醒及隐藏行情界面。适合需要在 DSH 对话中查市场数据并管理自选标的的用户。行情数据来自雪球公开接口；可选在手动同步时连接同花顺账本，不需要 API Key。

dsh-market-dock adds a market panel and Agent tools to DSH web. It shows A-share, Hong Kong, and US quotes, charts, hot lists, news, and search. Users can manage local holdings, view P&L, set price alerts, or hide the UI. Quotes come from Xueqiu; THS ledger sync is optional. No API key is needed.

dsh-market-dock 的功能「行情与证券搜索」：Agent 工具可按名称、拼音、代码或 ticker 搜索证券，并读取 A 股、港股、美股、指数和 ETF 的实时行情快照。
dsh-market-dock 的功能「历史走势」：Agent 可按标的和周期获取 OHLCV K 线；面板另提供 K 线与分时详情图，可切换多个周期。
dsh-market-dock 的功能「本地持仓与盈亏」：在持仓页增删改本地持仓，宿主结合雪球报价计算市值及盈亏；用户点击同步时可选从同花顺账本导入或校对。
dsh-market-dock 的功能「价格提醒」：用户为标的设置上限或下限，宿主侧 watcher 检查触发情况并由浏览器通知器显示系统通知。
dsh-market-dock 的功能「行情隐身」：Agent 可读取或切换行情显示状态；隐藏时面板、徽标和指数条卸载，用户可用恢复入口重新显示。
dsh-market-dock 使用雪球行情接口读取报价、新闻等市场数据；同花顺账本仅在用户手动同步时请求。

触发后面板、徽标、指数条**一起卸载**（不是 CSS 隐藏），行情轮询随之停止——真的一个行情请求都不发；价格提醒仍然生效。

恢复有三条路，**成本刻意做得比隐藏更低**：

| 入口 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 左下角恢复胶囊 | 屏幕左下角一枚 `● 行情` 小胶囊，**单击即恢复**（也支持 Enter / Space） |

dsh-market-dock README · 常见问题：**Q: 面板挡住输入框怎么办？**
面板在输入框**上方**、对话区内，按 Esc 或点右上「收起」折叠；徽标可以拖到任意角落，位置会记住。

**Q: 为什么有时不刷新了？**
非交易时段会拉长刷新间隔；隐身状态下则完全停掉行情请求。想看最新的点「刷新」，或确认没在隐身模式（看左下角有没有 `● 行情` 胶囊）。

**Q: 数据准吗？**
行情来自雪球公开接口，和雪球网页同源；盈亏是「本地持仓 × 行情」的现算结果，股数/成本价以你填的为准。交易时段按周一至周五固定钟点本地推算，**不含法定节假日调休**，仅供参考。

**Q: Cookie 会不会泄露？**
不会出本机。它只存在 `$DSH_HOME` 下的本地文件里，由宿主进程使用；客户端与 Agent 工具都拿不到原文。

**Q: 会不会影响 DSH 本体？**
不会。所有 UI 都挂在官方槽位（`conversation.input.dock` / `shell.overlay` / `conversation.composer.dock`），卸载即完全消失，不改 DSH 源码。

dsh-market-dock README · Quotes and watchlist：The **Market** tab shows the four indices on top and your watchlist below; click a row for the detail view. "Refresh" triggers an update manually; otherwise polling adapts to the trading session (long back-off after close) with TTL caching and request throttling.

dsh-market-dock README · Holdings and P&L：Positions in the **Positions** tab are the source of truth, stored in a local file:

- Add a position by symbol + shares + cost; edit or delete at any time.
- "Sync from ledger" is an optional one-off import / reconciliation against the THS ledger. It only issues a request when clicked.
- Day P&L = local holdings × live Xueqiu quotes. An expired ledger Cookie or a broken ledger endpoint does not affect it.

dsh-market-dock README · Price alerts：Set an upper or lower bound per symbol and get a system notification when it is crossed. Detection runs in a host-side watcher, so closing the panel, refreshing the page or collapsing the badge does not stop alerts. If notification permission is missing, you will be asked on the first trigger (the hide button and the restore pill also request it as a side effect of a user gesture).

dsh-market-dock README · Hiding the market：| Entry point | How |
|---|---|
| Restore pill | A small `● Market` pill in the bottom-left corner; **a single click restores** (Enter / Space also work) |
| Keyboard shortcut | `Ctrl + Alt + Shift + X` (`⌘ + Alt + Shift + X` on macOS), rebindable in **Settings → General → Shortcuts** |
| Agent tool | Ask the model to call `xueqiu_display` with `hidden: false`, or just say "bring the market back" |

dsh-market-dock README · Hiding the market：The hidden flag is **host-level**, stored in `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/.xueqiu-ui-state.json` — it survives refresh, restart, workspace switches and browser changes.

dsh-market-dock README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `xueqiu_quote` | Real-time quote snapshot (A-share / HK / US / index / ETF) |
| `xueqiu_kline` | Historical K-lines (OHLCV + change), for trend analysis and indicators |

dsh-market-dock README · Data and privacy：- **No cloud account, no API key.** By default the plugin scrapes Xueqiu's public web endpoints without logging in.
- **Optional login**: paste a Cookie from your browser to pull your cloud watchlist and best-effort sync add/remove. The Cookie is stored only in a local host file; neither the client nor the agent tools ever see the raw value.
- All state lives in local files:

dsh-market-dock README · Data and privacy：| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/.xueqiu-watchlist.json` | Watchlist + last cloud sync time |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/.xueqiu-ui-state.json` | UI state (panel open, badge position/collapse, **hide flag**) |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/.xueqiu-login.json` | Optional login Cookie |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/.xueqiu-alerts.json` | Alert rules and fired events |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ths-pnl/config.json` | Optional ledger Cookie (shared with the retired `dsh-ths-pnl`) |
| `$DSH_HOME/dsh-ths-pnl/positions.json` | Local holdings (shares / cost) |

dsh-market-dock README · Data and privacy：- Nothing is uploaded to third parties. Besides Xueqiu (quotes) and the optional THS ledger, no outbound requests are made.

dsh-market-dock README · Relationship to upstream dsh-xueqiu：- This is a **replacement**, not a companion: agent tool names stay `xueqiu_*`, so running both registers duplicate tools. Uninstall `dsh-xueqiu` before installing this.
- The default state directory is still `$DSH_HOME/dsh-xueqiu/`, so watchlist, Cookie and UI position carry over when switching; set a different `stateDir` in the plugin config to isolate completely (existing data is not migrated automatically).
- Upstream improvements are welcome back at [wanderer-yk/dsh-xueqiu](https://github.com/wanderer-yk/dsh-xueqiu).

dsh-market-dock README · Requirements：Targets DSH 0.2+ (after the host `shell` service rename) and is verified there; earlier versions are untested.

dsh-market-dock README · FAQ：**The panel covers the composer?**
It sits above the composer inside the conversation area; press Esc or use "collapse". The badge can be dragged anywhere and remembers its position.

**Why did it stop refreshing?**
Polling backs off outside trading hours, and stops entirely while hidden. Click "Refresh", or check whether the `● Market` pill is in the bottom-left corner.

dsh-market-dock README · FAQ：**Is the data accurate?**
Quotes come from Xueqiu's public endpoints, the same source as the Xueqiu website. P&L is computed as local holdings × quotes — shares and cost are whatever you entered. Trading sessions are inferred locally for Mon–Fri at fixed hours, **excluding public-holiday adjustments**; for reference only.

dsh-market-dock README · FAQ：**Can the Cookie leak?**
No, it stays on your machine: it lives in a file under `$DSH_HOME` and is used by the host process. Neither the client bundle nor agent tools receive it.

**Does it patch DSH itself?**
No. All UI is mounted on official slots (`conversation.input.dock` / `shell.overlay` / `conversation.composer.dock`) and disappears completely when uninstalled.
